items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And Eddy Green was on this show.

ctx.x: Well, anyhow, that's what happened, anyhow, so they all got other job, see? They eventually got jobs.

Well, when I got this show, I had to reorganize the band. The only one I had with me when I reorganized the band was the drummer. The rest of them had left. Now, here's what happened. We take the show out, and for the first time, I was stranded. This was my first strand. We got as far as Indianapolis. And Eddy Green was on this show. He was one of our first-class comedians. He and the man that owned the show, was called Friedenwald, that's 'free forest', Friedenwald.
